question: After034 shape LR/16 still failed, separate endpoint mean geometry, stochastic heads and their feature/amplitude interaction on the same TRAIN banks without an update.

design.banks: Exactly the eight previously examined033 TRAIN diagnostic banks, excluding the first-gradient bank. No low-Q selection or new bank.
design.sampling: Independent uniform-with-replacement SOURCE64+64 and REAL128+128 streams per bank; identical cached indices/latents/electronics/targets across all six states.

factorization.M: All mean_model.* state entries from independently selected initial/final CP.
factorization.R: All other model state entries: basis_head, charge_head, envelope_head and local_filter.
factorization.construction: Build every corner directly from endpoint dictionaries and strict-load; never accumulate deltas.
factorization.cached_A: Use A0 already returned by M0R0 and Af already returned by MfRf; no additional model call.
factorization.common_random_numbers: Cache independent source A/B and REAL T/U indices, response latents, original005 noise and all three H extensions once per bank; reuse across all six states.

design.primary: All six states: three-H-average data energy and wave/integral/carrier parts.
design.four_corner_secondary: Model regular mean/basis/charge/local, saturation and true full objective. A-only has no model regular/full total.
design.statistical_order: Compute contrasts inside each bank, then mean/MCSE and descriptive3MCSE across the eight reused banks.

measurements: Three-H energy wave, joint signed-integral and centered-carrier components, saturation and hard-observation flags with row denominators.
Pure pre-ADC A and signal canonical Q, negative area, carrier RMS, absolute/positive peaks and search-support/boundary counts.
Physical B RMS and B-RMS/A-RMS, v norm/log variance, alpha, local envelope/realization and mean-residual saturation.
Decoded/pooled RMS from a read-only UNet hook on the same64 calls; no extra forward.
State digests, identity hashes, counters and paired algebra; no saved waveform bank or checkpoint writes.

input_policy.binding: All input/source SHA pins are checked before decoding. Check initial/final034 schema, updates0/2000, equal config/stats/scales and frozen005 binding.

budget_derivation.NN: 4 corners *8 banks *2 generated banks =64 calls;64*64=4096 rows.
budget_derivation.electronics: 8 banks *2 generated banks *64=1024 original005 rows; three H=3072 extension rows.
budget_derivation.generated_ADC: 6 states *8 banks *2 generated banks *64 rows *3 H=18432 hard ADC rows; A-only uses cached A.
budget_derivation.REAL: One existing-ADC CPU observation of21047 REAL rows. No redigitization or second observation per H.

success_definition: Engineering success means exact state/source/input binding, complete bounded outputs and counters. No response-match gate or candidate selection.
scientific_limits: A-only deterministic mean plus electronics is not E[hard observed waveform|source], because ADC, first-argmax cropping and normalization are nonlinear.
Marginal REAL data energy does not identify eventwise conditional response or supply nonexistent parent labels.
M effects include changed shared decoded/pooled features and A amplitude seen by fixed random heads; R effects and interaction are functional comparisons at these endpoint states.
The exchange does not establish a training-history cause or resolve the hard finite-difference versus STE gradient discrepancy.
No best corner is selected and no acceptance gate is introduced.
preparation_checks: Only AST compilation, text dependency closure, hashes, metadata equality and integer budget arithmetic. No project import, NN, AD, CP deserialize, raw array decode, observation or optimizer.
freeze_required: Independent static review and ROOT frozen ready configuration plus external supervisor/project lock before execution.
historical_preservation: Only the new035 script and these three preparation JSON files are written. Old source/results/ledgers remain byte-identical.
